ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of sunshine hours in some cities of China in a certain year, the horizontal axis marks months 1 to 12, and the vertical axis is sunshine hours (hours). The legend lists four cities: Beijing, Harbin, Shanghai, and Lhasa, with each city represented by a different column style. According to the legend, after finding the column style corresponding to "Shanghai", observe the height of the columns of that style month by month along the horizontal axis. Then reason: Comparing Shanghai's column heights in the 12 months, the Shanghai column corresponding to July is the highest, indicating that the month with the most sunshine hours in Shanghai is July.

method.method_draft: 先观察图像中的统计图：横轴是1—12月，纵轴是日照时数，图例给出不同城市对应的柱形样式。根据题干文字确定只需要找“上海市”。在图例中找到标注为“上海”的柱形样式，然后沿横轴逐月查看这种样式的柱子高度，比较12个月中哪一个最高。可见上海对应柱形在7月份最高，因此答案为7月份。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一幅某年我国部分城市日照时数统计柱状图，横轴标出1到12月，纵轴为日照时数（小时）。图例列出北京、哈尔滨、上海、拉萨四个城市，各城市用不同柱形样式表示。根据图例，找到“上海”对应的柱形样式后，沿横轴逐月观察该样式柱子的高度。再推理：比较上海在12个月中的柱高，7月份对应的上海柱形最高，说明上海市日照时数最多的月份是7月份。
